model.name: gradient_boosting
model.selection_reason: Gradient Boosting Regressor selected. The best non-tree candidate (Multi-Layer Perceptron Regressor) was ahead by only -0.0156 R-squared, inside the 0.02 margin, so the exact-SHAP-explainable model is preferred -- explainability is a stated requirement and the accuracy difference does not pay for losing it.

escalation_rule: A case is visible to a welfare officer only when it is currently High, or has been Moderate or above for 3 consecutive snapshots with a rising trend. Everyone else is scored and can see their own result, but is not shown to an officer.

conformal.note: Coverage is with respect to the label the model was trained on. On the synthetic corpus that label is the generator's formula plus injected noise; the interval quantifies model error against that label and is not validation against real welfare outcomes.
